description: The file defines an asynchronous function that creates an alert for a manufacturing OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) system when OEE falls below a target threshold. It interacts with database models to check existing alerts and insert new alert records, incorporating logic to avoid duplicates.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Database model representing an alert generated in the system.

classes.name: AlertType
classes.description: Enumeration or class defining different types of alerts, including OEE_BELOW_TARGET.

classes.name: Line
classes.description: Database model representing a production line, including its target OEE.

classes.name: OEEResult
classes.description: Data class or object representing the OEE calculation results, including metrics like oee, availability, performance, and quality.

methods.name: Optional[Alert] maybe_create_oee_alert( db: AsyncSession, *, line_id: int, run_id: Optional[int], shift_id: Optional[int], oee_result: OEEResult, )
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a warning alert if an OEE measurement falls below the line's target, avoiding duplicates for the same line+run if an unresolved alert already exists.

ctags.name: maybe_create_oee_alert
ctags.signature: ( db: AsyncSession, *, line_id: int, run_id: Optional[int], shift_id: Optional[int], oee_result: OEEResult, )
